description: An agent wants to pay or sign. Exactly one of url (pay an x402 API) or sign (a transaction, approval or signature, presign-guard's /v1/check body).

url.description: The x402 endpoint the agent wants to pay

method.description: HTTP method of that endpoint (default GET)

sign.description: What the agent wants to sign, in presign-guard's /v1/check body: { type, chainId, ... }

note.description: Why the agent wants to pay (shown back in the reply)
